chapter: Brawls, the Ink Spots and boyhood recollections
title: Knocking out a policeman on the sidewalk
summary: At the top of the stairs a policeman is clubbing Buck; Bubbles dodges the club, knocks the officer out, and pins two cops to a wall.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: think I'm down there. The ones on top thinks I'm under there and I'm over here behind them, you know? And I look at the bunch and I go upstairs, right there, I go up the stairs. I get to the top of the stairs and I wonder why Buck don't come on out. No, Buck don't come out right then. So I waited a couple of minutes at the top of the stairs and here comes Buck and a policeman has got Buck by the arm, by his right arm. And the policeman has got the club in his right hand, hitting Buck with the club. Understand?

When they get up to the top of the stairs there's a sidewalk then because it goes from the sidewalk down in the hole, you know. When get get up on the sidewalk -- now I'm saying to the policeman, "He's with me." Why did I say that for? The police drew back the club to hit me and I scooted out from under it, scooted away from him -- you know how you scoot back -- I scooted back from the club so he missed me and when he straightened up, he

straightened up with a right because I hit him up the side of his head and down he went, knocked him out -- now, I'm not hitting just with me, I've got everything hitting with me. I got all the right to hit him and I've got the right hitting him and the power of the right. So when I knocked him out, understand, up comes the policeman on the beat -- comes up and he comes running with a gun in his hand and Buck runs up to the policeman, says, "Don't shoot him. Don't shoot him." Now I take Buck and the policeman and back them against the wall of the building. I get them against the wall of the building, this policeman is trying to get up and I'm going over to the policeman to keep him from getting up, that's when the other cop -- see now this cop that hit on the sidewalk with his club getting more help and when this cop decides to get up and I go to the cop, the other cop comes up the street with a gun in his hand. Understand? When I grabbed the cop that came

up the street with a gun in his hand and the cop that was trying to get me off him, I pulled both against the wall with Buck in the middle of 'em. And somethin' says "leave." Just like that and I was the mast on picking up on any kind of clue I got. I pick up on the stage the same way. I get a cue on something, pick it up.
